brief.aim: The table is line-item retail transactions with no plausible recorded outcome, so the evident aim is segmenting customers into behavioural groups; because segments are built from static per-customer aggregates of transactions, timestamps are not used for partitioning, per RL-0004.
brief.repeated_subjects: CustomerID repeats across many transaction-line rows, so each customer contributes multiple rows that must be aggregated and kept in one partition.
brief.unit: customer (CustomerID), aggregated from that customer's invoice lines
